releaseNotes: Reverted execution level to standard user privileges (asInvoker in app.manifest)
Implemented single-instance enforcement via system-wide Mutex with foreground activation
Enabled immediate, clean process termination upon main window close (ShutdownMode.OnMainWindowClose)
Updated typography application-wide to Google Font 'Outfit' (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold)
Removed legacy Jersey25 font files and references across styles and XAML views
Streamlined background task cancellation and tray cleanup upon window closure
